scope: Files specified by the instrument guide and named analytical products. A shared ledger can be updated in more than one stage. Reading URLs resolve relative to the stage page.

groups.description: disagreements.jsonl records each ruling, diagnosis and supporting evidence. assign_final.jsonl records the resulting placements under the current scheme. adjudication_report.md explains the pattern of rulings and what remains uncertain.

groups.purpose: Author, reader and community coder differences
groups.description: transmission-B4.md separates kinds of disagreement between author and readers. coder_conflicts.jsonl records conflicts in the community coding, so a later claim shows any incompatible readings of the same material.

RETURN-B4.md tells the new readers how to answer. reassign.jsonl keeps their placements for comparison with the settled record. transmission-after-revision-B4.md reports that comparison, including the separate samples; despite its file name, B4 leaves the category scheme as B2 froze it.

notes-B4.md records choices of method, remaining problems and open questions for C1. The stage's run_manifest.json entry records the reader setup. Together these let a reviewer tell a technical repair from a judgment on substance and from a scheme revision left for C1.
The aggregator’s closing account of this stage and what it passed to the next.
